data.title: 英梨梨 · 先记住这块颜色
data.description: 展厅长椅上，英梨梨摊开随身速写本，记下刚才那幅画的配色。她没急着画轮廓，只在纸角试了几块颜色。
data.promptProse: Eriri sits on a gallery bench in a camel beret, cream cardigan, and navy midi dress. She makes a few small color swatches in an open sketchbook with a colored pencil, considering the palette rather than copying a whole painting. Soft gallery lights illuminate the quiet room.
data.animaCaption: The sketchbook rests on her lap while the pencil makes small swatches near a page corner.
data.action: 坐在展厅长椅上记下几块配色
